title: Vietnam Renewable Generation and Avoided Emissions
thesis: Snowflake turns daily plant data from a fictional Vietnamese renewable power producer into meter-data quality, outage, generation, estimated avoided-emissions, availability and grievance KPIs, 7-day outage-risk scores, equipment temperature anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Valid meter intervals, generation outages, total generation and estimated avoided emissions for 30 solar, wind and small hydro plants across 4 Vietnamese cities.

Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to plant-day rows. Avoided emissions use an internal demo emission factor and are estimates, not carbon credits.
The root-cause chart shows that governor faults leave the most meter intervals invalid on outage days.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of plant KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which plants are likely to have the next forced outage?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores the probability that each plant has a forced generation outage in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags power-conversion equipment temperature outliers per plant, and the forecast projects portfolio-wide estimated avoided CO2e for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How healthy is the maintenance work behind those risks?

talking_points: Plant availability, survey defects closed and community grievances frame the portfolio's operating health.
Preventive inspection completion against meter data valid by plant is a synthetic association, not evidence of cause.
The action memo is drafted from the KPI, outage, root-cause and risk tables only, and needs human review.
show: Availability, defect closure and grievance cards
tabs.call_out: From KPIs to a reviewed action memo in one place

transition.line: What is happening at the plants right now?

talking_points: Live equipment temperature and output readings land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through S3 and Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the plant's current risk band, then emails the plant operations lead.
tabs.call_out: From alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic outage-response SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
